correctness.rationale: For hub o and n≥2 disjoint complete blades, the higher-independence face condition is literally J=join_i Sk_(r−1)(V_i) when o absent and o*L with L=Sk_(r−2)(all leaves) when o present. The join J is contractible or a wedge of ∏ binom(m_i−1,r) spheres dimension nr−1, thus (r−2)-connected, while L has dimension ≤r−2. The inclusion L→J is null; the cone pushout is J∨ΣL. The standard skeleton Morse pairing gives binom(N−1,r−1) spheres in dimension r−1. The augmented boundary as contraction by the all-ones functional identifies top homology with wedge powers of integral augmentation lattices; the cone connecting homomorphism and join Künneth are equivariant. Swapping equal blade factors contributes Koszul (-1)^r. Independent exact mod-two chain ranks for (r;m_i)=(3;4,4),(3;3,3),(3;2,5),(4;5,5) agree with formula. All assumptions r≥3, n≥2, m_i≥1 and no equivariant homotopy wedge asserted.
